captions.detailed: This 3D model features a coastal defense embrasure cannon mounted on a broad, circular concrete barbette. The gun platform consists of a dark brown rectangular baseplate supporting two dark grey vertical carriage cheeks. Nestled between these cheeks is a long, black smooth-bore barrel that projects forward. The barrel is designed to pivot vertically (elevation) via a revolute trunnion joint, while the entire platform assembly can rotate horizontally (traverse) on a continuous revolute bearing atop the concrete base.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a coastal defense embrasure cannon. It should feature a thick, circular concrete barbette base, a rotating rectangular brown platform carriage with dark grey vertical supports, and an elevating black smooth-bore barrel. Implement two joints: a continuous horizontal revolute joint to traverse the platform on the base, and a revolute joint to elevate the barrel within the carriage cheeks.
captions.factory: The code constructs three main parts: a concrete base, a platform, and a barrel. The base is built by fusing a wide cylinder with a slightly smaller cylinder on top. The platform consists of a flat rectangular box as the floor, a central circular ring, two vertical parallel plates (carriage cheeks) made of combined boxes, and a rear wedge block. The barrel is constructed using a series of cylinders of varying radii, a sphere for the cascabel, and horizontal cylinders for the trunnions. Finally, two joints are defined: a continuous revolute joint (Z-axis) connecting the platform to the base, and a revolute joint (Y-axis) connecting the barrel to the platform.
